scope: Selected64 source and cadence damage sensitivity, not measured component lifetime or qualification. Planar CSDA path identified with depth; straggling/roughness/recoil cascades omitted. Ed sensitivities and stopping multipliers are scenarios, not credible intervals. Total ZBL elastic transfer is used as a conservative-leaning NRT damage-energy proxy, without recoil electronic partition or dynamic annealing; electronic excitation damage is separate.
prompt_scope: Imported homogeneous first-interaction depth proxy. Resolved-depth no-conduction maximum scales inversely with cp and is independent of conductivity. Only the sub-keV surface tail is rescaled with effusivity. Treating the low-k skin as a half-space is conservative relative to an ideally contacted higher-k backing for surface heat. A true layered photon/electron transient and interfaces remain uncomputed. Material and prompt peaks occur at different times.
restoration_scope: Gross internally recycled skin throughput. Full reworking is a sensitivity, not a prescribed action at each period. Existing factory capacity is held fixed; capacity above it must be reassigned/added. At 2 MJ/kg this is a chosen complete process cost, with no extra atomization energy. Retained matter is not fresh feed. No achieved annual skin life is inferred.
